name: Pale as Death
body:
Prerequisite(s): deathly pallor class feature.

Benefit(s): Select a deathly pallor you qualify for. Add deathly pallor to the list of effects you can choose from when you use necrosis shroud.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you take it, select a new deathly pallor.
